notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES:

Leaderboard Improvements & Bug Fixes
- Improvements and fixes to the leaderboard system.

New Common Items
- Glasses (Common): Grants a chance for a rare item instead of a common one on the next level up.
- Wallet (Common): Golden words give an additional 8% gold.
- Water Bottle (Common): Increases day length by 5%.
- Light Bulb (Common): Places 2 torches.

New Legendary Items
- Nuke (Legendary): Introduces a chance for a nuke to appear every day.
- Satellite (Legendary): Adds a chance for an airstrike to appear every day.
- Nitrogen (Legendary): Barricades freeze the closest +1 enemy to the player upon destruction.
- Night Vision Goggles (Legendary): Slightly enhances visibility during night darkness. (trough the darkness itself)

Fixes
- Removed mouse input from typing to prevent mistakes.

New Mechanics
- Bad Events >:)
- Introduced a new mechanic where every 15 days there is a 20% chance for a bad event to occur:
1. Horde Attack
2. The Darkest Night
3. Traitor Thief
4. New Mutation

PS. This is a duplicate upload because i forgot to remove test code from the previously uploaded release xd Lol sorry im a noob

notes.title: Version 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
-----------

- Spotlight Buff:
  - Light intensity increased from 41% to 51%.

- Torch Upgrade Adjustment:
  - Emergency nerf of the Torch Upgrade. The light amount was too powerful, making the night obsolete at Level 2. This has been adjusted accordingly.

- Cotton Item Nerf:
  - Light amount reduced from 15% to 9%.

- Cloth Item Nerf:
  - Light amount reduced from 11% to 8%.

notes.title: Version 1.1.3
notes.notes:
NEW ITEMS
-New common item: Cloth - Increases torch power.
-New common item: Gum - Increases mud slowness.
-New rare item: Vitamins - Weakens enemies.
-New legendary item: Kevlar - Barricades have a chance to block attacks.
-New legendary item: Antidote - Allows the player to survive additional zombie hits.
BUFFS
-Buff torch upgrade perks: 10s → 25s duration time.
-Buff chips: +30% effectiveness.
-Buff binoculars: +25% effectiveness.
NERFS
-Nerf reroll: 3 rerolls → 1 reroll starting.
-Nerf wood health perk: 2 → 1.
-Nerf silver health perk: 5 → 3.
-Nerf flashlight effectiveness: 30% → 20%.
-Nerf spotlight effectiveness: 70% → 45%.
-Nerf metal detector effectiveness: -35%.
-Nerf compass effectiveness: -15%.
-Nerf legendary item appearance rate: -1%.
-Nerf dog effectiveness: -30%.
-Nerf honey effectiveness: to 14%.
-Nerf rooster effectiveness: -25%.
-Darkness sets in more quickly.
-Greatly increased overall difficulty after day 30.
BUG FIXES
-Fixed a bug where fireworks did not trigger on barricade break.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Changes:
-Improved typing algorithm
-Frozen enemies cannot shuffle words
-Lowered amount of confusing zombies (changing words) by 30%
-Lowered spawn rate of zombies by 35%
-Zombies add more xp the further you go
-Rubbish zombies (random sequence of letters) will have less symbols overall
-Upon leveling up you can see what items you have picked previously
-Barricades health reduced by 35%
-Added skins! You can get them by playing the game and collecting cans of tomato soup lol
